solution_spec.author: solx-loop
solution_spec.description: Textbook CUDA kernel: 16 threads per row, 256-bit loads/stores, L2 evict_first loads, L2 evict_last stores

args.note: r14 fresh eyes: textbook 256-bit kernel + L2 evict_first loads / evict_last stores

args.script:
import torch, triton, triton.language as tl, b200probe as bp
@triton.jit
def rms_kernel(q, k, wq, wk, oq, ok, nrows, eps, ROWS: tl.constexpr):
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    nprog_per = tl.cdiv(nrows, ROWS)
    is_k = pid >= nprog_per
    pid = tl.where(is_k, pid - nprog_per, pid)
    x = tl.where(is_k, k, q); w = tl.where(is_k, wk, wq); o = tl.where(is_k, ok, oq)
    rows = pid * ROWS + tl.arange(0, ROWS)
    cols = tl.arange(0, 128)
    mask = (rows < nrows)[:, None]
    offs = rows[:, None].to(tl.int64) * 128 + cols[None, :]
    v = tl.load(x + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0, eviction_policy="evict_first")
    ww = tl.load(w + (rows % 48)[:, None] * 128 + cols[None, :], mask=mask, other=0.0)
    s = tl.sum(v * v, axis=1) / 128.0
    r = tl.rsqrt(s + eps)
    tl.store(o + offs, v * r[:, None] * ww, mask=mask, eviction_policy="evict_last")
for ROWS, nw in [(8,4),(16,4),(16,8),(32,8)]:
    line = f"triton ROWS={ROWS} nw={nw}:"
    for B,S in [(1,128),(2,293),(8,128),(4,1024),(1,8192)]:
        q = torch.randn(B,S,48,128, device='cuda'); kk = torch.randn_like(q)
        wq = torch.randn(48,128, device='cuda'); wk = torch.randn_like(wq)
        oq = torch.empty_like(q); ok = torch.empty_like(q); n = B*S*48
        def fn(q,kk,wq,wk,oq,ok):
            rms_kernel[(2*triton.cdiv(n,ROWS),)](q,kk,wq,wk,oq,ok,n,1e-6,ROWS=ROWS,num_warps=nw)
        fn(q,kk,wq,wk,oq,ok); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        rq = (q*torch.rsqrt(q.pow(2).mean(-1,keepdim=True)+1e-6))*wq
        okk = torch.allclose(oq,rq,atol=1e-5,rtol=1e-5)
        t = bp.harness_time(fn, [q,kk,wq,wk], [oq,ok])
        line += f" {B}x{S}: {t:.2f}{'' if okk else '!'}"
    print(line)
h = rms_kernel.warmup(q,kk,wq,wk,oq,ok,n,1e-6,ROWS=16,num_warps=4,grid=(1,))
import re; print("regs", h.n_regs, sorted(set(re.findall(r'(?:LDG|STG)\.[A-Z0-9\.]+', h.asm['sass']))))
